pkgmetadata.longdescription: Strata is an inference engine for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (and, in the terminal's catalogue, Tencent Hy4-Flash and Thinking Machines Inkling-2-Mini) on consumer NVIDIA and AMD hardware, with an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API served on localhost and a terminal client that picks, verifies and starts the engine. The engine built here runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in several GSQ-RCO, Q2_0 and UD quantizations, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B in Unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL and Q8_0 GGUFs. The terminal refuses unsupported GGUF files, including other Qwen3.8 sizes. The catalogue also lists Tencent Hy4-Flash and Thinking Machines Inkling-2-Mini, whose model files the terminal can prepare, but each engine is a separate upstream component (strata-hy4 and strata-inkling) that this package does not build. The engine is built for one GPU backend (CUDA or ROCm HIP) and installed as an engine component that the terminal verifies against a SHA-256 manifest at every start.

use.flag: Build the engine for NVIDIA GPUs with the CUDA toolkit
Build the engine for AMD GPUs with the ROCm HIP toolchain
Install the strata terminal and API server, which need the Python dependencies; without it only the engine component is installed
Build the picture reader (strata-vision) from tools/vision, so a prompt can carry images; without it the engine answers text only
